sources.name: rpki-client console
sources.what: All validated ROAs (VRPs) and ASPAs from the five RIR trust anchors (rpki.json), plus each ASN's object page, used for where the objects are published.

sources.name: RIPEstat announced-prefixes
sources.what: Exact prefixes each ASN announces, as seen by RIPE RIS route collectors (at least 10 RIS peers, last 24 hours).

sources.name: RIPEstat asn-neighbours
sources.what: Neighbours seen on the upstream side of each routed ASN in RIS AS paths, compared with ASPA provider sets.

sources.name: RIPEstat country-resource-list
sources.what: ASNs that RIPE NCC has delegated to Norway (NO).

sources.name: ipverse asn-info
sources.what: Network names for every ASN, and ASNs whose registry country is NO (added to the RIPE NCC list).
